summary: Remove the OpenZFS CI publish gate and purge manifest-based publish policy from workflows, release scripts, tests, operator docs, plans, QA and historical change wording. Release publish depends on deploy secrets only. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Release and verification docs no longer describe OpenZFS as a publish gate.

api.reason: CI publish policy and documentation only; no Controller/Core API contract change.

roadmap.reason: Publication policy cleanup; no milestone status change.

state.reason: No durable pool or Controller state; release publish behaviour and docs only.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest tests.test_ci_security tests.test_release_publish tests.test_gitea_release tests.test_release_reachability; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. rg for check-zfs-blocked, NEX_PUBLISH_WITH_ZFS, ZFS-enabled ISO, ZFS-containing manifest, and publication scripts reject in workflows, scripts, guide, and installer README returns no matches.
